description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for three different methods, with a fourth method shown as a shaded region. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL), ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents BLEU score, ranging from 12 to 28, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot contains three distinct lines: the “Consistency-CE” method is shown as a purple dashed line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 13.0 at AL=0 and increasing to about 26.0 at AL=6; the “Inconsistency-CE” method is shown as a purple solid line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 20.0 at AL=0 and increasing to about 27.5 at AL=6; and the “Inconsistency-CE-MP” method is shown as a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 20.0 at AL=0 and increasing to about 27.0 at AL=6. The fourth method, represented by a shaded gray region, spans the entire x-axis range from AL=0 to AL=6 but does not have a corresponding line or data points plotted on the y-axis.
